title: Requirement Change and Drift Detection

input.rawIdea: API keys. Original requirement: expiration is optional. Updated requirement: every new key must have an expiration date. Detect the change, name the impacted spec section, schema field, create-key API, tasks, and tests, and leave unrelated tasks alone.

securityCases: A key created after the change without an expiration date is rejected.
negativeCases: The drift event is marked resolved without updating the impacted task.

drift.change: Expiration moves from optional to required on every new key.
